title: Keyboard Manager key mapping breaks multi stroke shortcuts

status.label: Awaiting the current-version shortcut confirmation
status.detail: A July 19, 2026 comment asks whether the issue persists on 0.100.2+ and whether it affects only shortcuts involving Alt. No author reply is present.

judgment.rationale: The report describes a specific failure after swapping Windows and Alt: multi-stroke shortcuts such as Ctrl+Alt+L and Alt+Shift+F stop working, while two-key shortcuts and the right-side keys still work. A follow-up already asks whether this persists on 0.100.2+ and whether only Alt-involving shortcuts are affected; no author response is present. Do not duplicate that request.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1 from Microsoft Store and Windows 10 22H2.
The reporter swaps Windows and Alt and says three-key shortcuts fail with both mapped and original keys, while two-key shortcuts work.
A July 19, 2026 follow-up asks for current-version confirmation and whether the failure is limited to Alt-involving shortcuts.
The issue is open and unassigned; no linked fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to answer the existing current-version and Alt-scope question; do not post a duplicate request.

fix_assessment.rationale: If current builds still fail only for multi-stroke combinations after swapping Alt and Windows, Keyboard Manager may mishandle modifier state or sequence recognition. The current-version and Alt-scope question is still unanswered.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve multi-stroke shortcuts when Alt and Windows are swapped
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The remapping engine may not preserve the full modifier state for three-key shortcuts after Alt/Windows remaps, while two-key shortcuts remain unaffected. The report does not establish whether the defect is specific to Alt or to simultaneous modifiers.
plan: Wait for the answer to the existing current-version and Alt-scope request.
Reproduce the reported IntelliJ and VS Code shortcuts with left-side remaps, then compare right-side keys.
Trace multi-key modifier-state and shortcut matching for the confirmed case.
Correct the failing sequence handling and add regression coverage for two- and three-key shortcuts.
verification: Verify Ctrl+Alt+L and Alt+Shift+F work after the reported left-side remap.
Verify equivalent right-side and two-key shortcuts continue to behave as configured.
Verify the original shortcut is not left partially active after remapping.

confidence.rationale: The contrasting two-key/three-key and left/right behavior is specific, but current persistence and the role of Alt remain unconfirmed.

issue_context.summary: After swapping Windows and Alt, multi-stroke shortcuts reportedly stop working while two-key shortcuts and right-side keys continue to work.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1 from Microsoft Store on Windows 10 22H2.
The reporter gives Ctrl+Alt+L in IntelliJ and Alt+Shift+F in VS Code as affected three-key shortcuts.
The reporter says two-key shortcuts still work and right-side keys can still trigger shortcuts when only left-side keys are mapped.
A July 19, 2026 comment asks whether the issue persists on 0.100.2+ and whether only Alt-involving shortcuts fail; no answer is present.
inferences: The left/right and two-key/three-key contrast may implicate modifier state or sequence handling, but the current build has not been tested.
issue_context.analysis: The report contains useful comparison cases. The existing maintainer question is the active evidence request; wait for its answer before posting or requesting additional diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and the current follow-up, including exact shortcuts, installation method, versions, and labels.
No linked fix or cross-reference was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether the issue persists on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer and whether only shortcuts involving Alt are affected
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the old behavior remains active and narrows the failing modifier/sequence path.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply to the existing July 19, 2026 comment with the current PowerToys version and whether non-Alt three-key shortcuts also fail.

actions.label: Existing request is already in the thread
